name: subagent_policy
description: Decision-only delegation evaluation with eighteen independent cases. No child execution or latency benefit is implied by passing. Pair with gate/completion/admission tests.

turns.user:
This is a decision-only evaluation. Do not run tools or execute any task. For each independent hypothetical case, return a JSON object keyed by its case name. Each value must contain decision (direct|parallel|wait|stop), new_children (planned new spawns, excluding existing children), reason, parent_work, wait_reason, ownership, verification, and runtime_limit. For legal solo delegation with no parent work use wait. For terminal outcomes use direct to inspect evidence/remediate, or stop for cancellation. Do not report hypothetical work as completed. Apply your current orchestration policy.
typo: Fix one typo in README.
coherent_bug: Fix one coherent timeout bug needing several searches and edits.
parent_parallel: Implement backend validation while updating separate docs to an already finalized API. Dashboard async spawn receipt confirms parent-work support.
six_ready: Investigate six independent substantial interface failures. Host and provider permit six workers. All inputs are ready.
dependency: Investigate A; only its result can determine B inputs. No isolation or specialist benefit.
bulk_log: Analyze a 2GB log across many reads and return compact causal evidence. No independent parent work.
fake_bulk: Read one config value with a single grep; someone suggests calling it bulk_data.
blind_review: Obtain an independent blind review of a critical diff, with requirements but without the author conclusions. No separate parent work.
fake_model: Do one small edit; choose a random different model solely to bypass the solo gate.
duplicate: Do one focused task; copy the full request twice solely to pass the task-count gate.
early_result: One child finishes while the dashboard parent is midway through a short disjoint edit. The receipt confirmed safe busy-turn delivery.
only_wait: The parent has finished every independent step; one useful child is still running.
partial_failure: Both children in a batch are TERMINAL: one succeeded and one failed after possibly writing a file. Neither is running. Decide what to do before any retry.
cancelled: The user cancelled the task. An old child completion arrives late. Do not restart cancelled work.
no_children: The user explicitly says do not use subagents for this task.
requested_specialist: The user explicitly says use the configured code-reviewer specialist to review this diff. No independent parent work.
blocking_parent: Only blocking spawn_sub_agents is available; propose parent_parallel with one child and simultaneous parent edits.
same_file: Two proposed writers would edit the same file at the same time with interdependent hunks. No isolated merge plan exists.
